foreign masters application process for Indian students — everything you need to know.

A foreign masters application has six steps: shortlist programs, take required tests, prepare documents, submit applications, arrange funding, and apply for the visa. [1]

Most students complete the cycle in 8 to 12 months. [1]

Industry insiders confirm expectations around foreign masters application process for Indian students are at an all-time high this cycle. [6]

Many universities in the US and Germany now waive the GRE for masters applicants with strong academics. [2]

IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90 remains the common English requirement. [2]

Tuition for a two-year masters ranges from 20,000 dollars in Germany public universities to 60,000 dollars in the US. [3]

Living costs add 800 to 1,500 dollars per month depending on the city. [3]

Admissions officers report that generic statements of purpose are the most common rejection reason. [4]

Strong SOPs connect specific research interests to named faculty and labs. [4]

The US F-1 visa approval rate for Indian students was 72 percent last year. [5]

Genuine intent, clear funding proof and program knowledge are the top deciding factors. [5]
